title: Minimum Absolute Difference Between Two Values
description:
You are given an array nums containing only 0, 1, and 2.

A pair (i, j) is valid if:

nums[i] == 1
nums[j] == 2
Task

Find the minimum absolute difference:

abs(i - j)

among all valid pairs.

If no such pair exists, return -1.

Examples

Example 1

[1,0,0,2,0,1]
→ 2

Example 2

[1,0,1,0]
→ -1
Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 100
Elements are only 0, 1, 2
input_format: Read from standard input. Format details depends on the problem.
constraints: Please read problem description for constraints.
